title: Qwen3.8 27B Q6_K on two RTX 5060 Ti 16GB cards
purpose: Experimental dual-card 131K Qwen3.8 route with f16 KV and tensor split 50,50.
caveats: Retrieval passed twice at ~115K prompt tokens, but only one of two sustained repeats produced the required client-visible output; the strict gate did not pass. Capable/experimental, not recommended.
The single-card IQ3_XXS 64K q8 route is the recommended Qwen3.8 preset.
131K is the highest tier tested here, not a maximum-context claim.
